ay.den0707: Arno "Smokes" Den took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

Arno "Smokes" Den fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Arno "Rabbit" Calin, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything. The Hegemony took Hill 304. Arno "Smokes" Den watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Arno "Smokes" Den wrote to five brothers, all on other fronts. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.
Arno "Smokes" Den found a flower growing out of a sandbag. He did not tell anyone. He checks on it every morning.
A loose thread in Arno "Smokes" Den's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.

Arno "Smokes" Den smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil came out for a cup and was grazed. A letter from home reached Arno "Smokes" Den before dusk. Arno "Smokes" Den read it twice and slept a little easier. Arno "Smokes" Den's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

A round went through the rim of Arno "Smokes" Den's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Oskar Perry of the Hegemony (@bo.perry._). Blackwater Canal is lost. Arno "Smokes" Den heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Arno "Smokes" Den is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Arno "Smokes" Den is number 348. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Arno "Smokes" Den read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Arno "Smokes" Den spent the day watching one loophole in the enemy line. At dusk a periscope rose in it. He let it go. Tomorrow.
There is a sniper across the way the men call the Widow. Three helmets went up on sticks today. the Widow hit all three. Arno "Smokes" Den watched where the shots came from.
beckforder873: On the way to N-F12, Silas "Mud" Beckforder tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

A patient apologized for bleeding on Silas "Mud" Beckforder's sleeve. He told the patient to concentrate on staying awake. Mail came up the line with a letter for Silas "Mud" Beckforder. Silas "Mud" Beckforder read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
brysen_miller1212: Edmund "Hollow" Miller introduced himself as a blacksmith from Wyvern Cross. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
Edmund "Hollow" Miller walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Edmund "Hollow" Miller owes Oskar Londonz so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Edmund "Hollow" Miller answered to number 878. Victory at Grey Mill. Edmund "Hollow" Miller let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Edmund "Hollow" Miller tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.
The last report placed Edmund "Hollow" Miller near the Brickworks. By evening, no later report had arrived. Missing.
darthtyronus: Lucien "Spark" Darthtyronus took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded. Lucien "Spark" Darthtyronus walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Lucien "Spark" Darthtyronus mended the hole in Viktor "Bones" Jcortes's trousers with fishing line and a bent pin. Bones says the patch is stronger than the trousers.
Lucien "Spark" Darthtyronus followed a cough through the fog and found the ration party stuck at a junction. For once, a cough improved supper.
david_jw_: Ulrich David introduced himself as a butcher's boy from Oakmere. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Ulrich David stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Ulrich David put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In T-F7, Ulrich David listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Ulrich David caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either.
A bucket appeared above the Hegemony parapet at the Brickworks. Ulrich David fired. Emil Axelnahumury pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.'
grizzlychicken1: Arno "Hollow" Grizzlychick unpacked a dented harmonica at S-C16. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-C16, Arno "Hollow" Grizzlychick listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Arno "Hollow" Grizzlychick has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib, badly wounded. Arno "Hollow" Grizzlychick got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 731. The men who came later will ask about it. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Arno "Hollow" Grizzlychick wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Arno "Hollow" Grizzlychick was hit twice at S-C16, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Felix Iqsanislami of the Hegemony (@iqsanislami). A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Arno "Hollow" Grizzlychick aimed just below it. Otto "Crow" Erenn was grazed. Arno "Hollow" Grizzlychick was hit at S-C16 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Felix Iqsanislami of the Hegemony (@iqsanislami).
Benedikt "Mole" Grizzlychick took the same post at S-C16 where Arno "Hollow" Grizzlychick stood. He found his brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
A shell blast threw Benedikt "Mole" Grizzlychick out of the trench at S-C16 and into the open. Men crawled out to drag him back.
gt3_di3go: After 9 days of war, T-S8 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Valentin Gtdigo.

Valentin Gtdigo came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir. A splinter opened Valentin Gtdigo's cheek at T-S8. A medic stitched it on the spot and he was back on the fire step before the tea went cold. Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Valentin Gtdigo wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Valentin Gtdigo walked back up the communication trench to T-S8, slower than before, but on his own feet. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached T-S8 with the rations. Valentin Gtdigo ate while listening to the revised orders.
Valentin Gtdigo kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.
Valentin Gtdigo of the Concord and Dorian "Lucky" Ihatethis of the Hegemony watched a broken branch near the Drowned Farm all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.
historylover1945: After 11 days of war, V-F10 had a place for everything. On Day 11, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Tobias Historylover. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into V-F10. Tobias Historylover has learned to walk bent double.
The bread had frozen at the edges. Tobias Historylover held it near the stove and defended the space with both elbows.
A clear shot from V-F10. Tobias Historylover badly wounded Gideon "Spark" Jaxk and slid back down below the parapet.
ikanbili_s: Albin Ikanbili signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at Q-S10 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.

Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Albin Ikanbili stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Ikanbili. Albin Ikanbili read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A muddy dog crawled into Q-S10 through the wire. Albin Ikanbili gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Biscuit. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Ikanbili. Albin Ikanbili read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Albin Ikanbili read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

The sergeant at Q-S10 called out a range and a spot. Albin Ikanbili was the only one who hit it. Viktor "Crow" Borgia was grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Ikanbili. Albin Ikanbili read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Albin Ikanbili of the Concord lost a harmonica in no man's land at Lantern Hill. Casimir Sky of the Hegemony found it and has been learning the enemy's songs on it.
james_servantofgod: Karel Servantofgod came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Karel Servantofgod kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Karel Servantofgod bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage. A letter from home reached Karel Servantofgod before dusk. Karel Servantofgod read it twice and slept a little easier. After the loss of Grey Mill, Karel Servantofgod helped stack spare sandbags at Q-S12. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Karel Servantofgod has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Ulrich Bear, badly wounded. A letter from home reached Karel Servantofgod before dusk. Karel Servantofgod read it twice and slept a little easier.

Karel Servantofgod practised asking for bread in the local language. The dugout supplied an audience and several confidently incorrect pronunciations. A letter from home reached Karel Servantofgod before dusk. Karel Servantofgod read it twice and slept a little easier.
king_baldwin_irl: Zeno Irl walked into R-F21 on Day 4 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Zeno Irl and Matthias Universal divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.

The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Zeno Irl ate two helpings anyway. The Hegemony secured Hill 304. Zeno Irl helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Dawn watch. Zeno Irl put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Quentin "Mud" Sperring, grazed.
Zeno Irl borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.
Zeno Irl fired at a movement across the wire at R-F21. The man went down: Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia, gravely wounded.
Zeno Irl fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Gustav Scottjseale, gravely wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-F21 changed before the cheering ended. Zeno Irl shouldered another load.

A borrowed pencil wore down while Zeno Irl was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first. The clerk counted the names twice. Zeno Irl is number 265 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Zeno Irl watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Zeno Irl watched the enemy lines change the guard at R-F21 every two hours, to the minute. At the next change, Silas Tadzyman was grazed.
Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Pavel Robertopropa stood up to sing louder, and Zeno Irl fired. Pavel Robertopropa was grazed. The singing stopped.
limaecho63: Marek Limaecho told the sergeant he was a lamplighter. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.

On sentry duty Marek Limaecho watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Marek Limaecho stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Marek Limaecho's ear at P-F23 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Clement Hanginbang of the Hegemony (@rusty_hanginbang).
Marek Limaecho rejoined the squad at P-F23. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
mark_lacy: Gideon "Rabbit" Lacy reported to U-F5 with a photograph gone soft at the edges sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.

Gideon "Rabbit" Lacy lent Leopold Daddy a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Gideon "Rabbit" Lacy looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Nobody else in U-F5 wanted the stripes. Gideon "Rabbit" Lacy said yes. Lance Corporal.

Gideon "Rabbit" Lacy was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at U-F5. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Norbert "Crow" Millii of the Hegemony (@mac_a_millii). Gideon "Rabbit" Lacy was killed at U-F5 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Norbert "Crow" Millii of the Hegemony (@mac_a_millii).
Ivo "Shadow" Lacy arrived carrying the family name of Gideon "Rabbit" Lacy. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
rhylerbetz: Benedikt Rhylerbetz came up on Day 7 carrying news from Marrow Fen. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Benedikt Rhylerbetz saw a hare run the whole length of no man's land and nobody on either side fired at it.
Benedikt Rhylerbetz turned a year older today. The whole squad sang for him, badly, and the cook found a candle.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-S6, Benedikt Rhylerbetz listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Benedikt Rhylerbetz and Henrik Rossfm carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident. Benedikt Rhylerbetz got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 471. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Benedikt Rhylerbetz read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Benedikt Rhylerbetz offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last.
At the Hanging Bridge, Benedikt Rhylerbetz and Roland Lovelightnin exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent.
totaltbecksvart: The sergeant gave Bastian Totaltbecksv a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 12 or any other.
A new recruit would not eat with the others. Bastian Totaltbecksv left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it.
